content: If the API FrIf_SetState with parameter FRIF_STATE_OFFLINE is called, the FlexRay Interface module shall check the parameter "TxConfCounter" for every PDU. If the value for the corresponding PDU is greater than 0, the FlexRay Interface shall call the upper layer using the API <UL>_TxConfirmation(id, E_NOT_OK).
